outcomeNote: A one-clause mishna, the next in the chapter's series of 'no less than / no more than' rules, stated without argument.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ אֵין בִּנְגָעִים פָּחוֹת מִשָּׁבוּעַ אֶחָד, וְלֹא יָתֵר עַל שְׁלֹשָׁה שְׁבוּעוֹת.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» There are symptoms of leprosy that a priest will immediately confirm to be ritually pure or ritually impure, and there are others for which the priest quarantines the leper in order to determine his status. «With regard to leprous marks, there is no» quarantine that is «less than one week and none greater than three weeks.»

moves.cueHe: אין בנגעים פחות משבוע אחד, ולא יתר על שלשה שבועות
moves.summary: the mishna states the one-to-three-week range of quarantine for leprous marks
